text: This policy excludes any loss, including but not limited to loss arising out of or directly or indirectly related to water.
We will pay the actual cash value of the damaged property within a reasonable time. The amount is based on the current manual.
We insure all direct physical loss to the dwelling, subject to all terms and except as provided in the exclusions.
The premium is calculated under the manual as amended from time to time using underwriting guidelines.
This mandatory endorsement is required by state law and must be endorsed for the policy.
